objective: Build one BUKLOD Main V30 signed production AAB, remove unjustified FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE from final manifest, retain Expo runtime 1.3.2 and production OTA channel; do not publish Google Play, OTA or web.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source main ce157c66f80978b0eb0d7f89c0766e0ca06c11dd includes verified V29 source and later Wall/Connect/staging changes. Successful V29 EAS build 84056134-678a-403e-a4a0-c88a7b2c5cb4 from bd0f0155. Production app config 1.3.5/code29. Existing old V30 PR #582 is unmerged and diverged; new branch starts fresh from main.
chosenApproach: Remove the explicit connectedDevice permission from the BUKLOD PTT plugin; add android.blockedPermissions to ensure merged manifests from transitive libraries remove it. Keep camera, microphone, VoIP, media playback, screen-share integrations intact. Build V30 1.3.6/code30 with runtime1.3.2 only after focused compatibility and compiled RC gates. EAS workflow verifies actual AAB manifest post-build.
selectionRationale: PTT uses Stream VoIP, not external-device foreground-service transport. Google Play foreground-service declaration should reflect real behavior. This permission removal is audited and narrow, without native JS ABI additions. Runtime stays 1.3.2 by explicit user direction.
